system.description:
You know how to handle an enemy when none of your allies is closer.

Prerequisite: Point-Blank Shot

Effect: If none of your allies are closer to your target than you are when you make a ranged attack, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. Your target must be at Short Range or closer to gain this bonus.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
